method: Local reran the current focused Playwright spec with Chromium, intercepted synthetic export, port 3000 and an output directory under the user temp directory. The spec read actual saved-file bytes before cleanup. Local separately reconstructed both fixture byte strings in Python and calculated hashlib SHA-256 without importing the B2b helper or the test oracle.
negativeControl: The two titles have the same length and produce 231-byte files, but their digests differ; accepting the wrong version would fail the focused spec's digest check.
cleanup: REMOVED by the focused test; Playwright output was outside the repository; no tracked file changed.
claimBoundary: One reviewer-owned synthetic Chromium run and independent byte-oracle recomputation. No production export route, provider, real data, governance behavior, print, clipboard, other-browser, store or artifact-acceptance proof.
